_doc: Hand-curated raw materials and substances of canon. Distinct from items (consumables) and tech (engineered). Includes seastone, magical/legendary woods, special metals.

materials.name: Sea Prism Stone (Kairoseki)
materials.notes: Solidified seawater. Nullifies Devil Fruit powers on contact. Forged into Marine cuffs, weapon edges, Impel Down floors, and ship-plating.

materials.name: Adam Wood (Treasure Tree Adam)
materials.notes: Sacred wood from a near-extinct giant tree. Hull material of the Oro Jackson and the Thousand Sunny. Effectively indestructible.

materials.name: Black Iron
materials.notes: Wano-mined dense iron used in samurai armour and ship-rigging. Heavier and harder than common steel.

materials.name: Wapametal
materials.notes: Munch-Munch metal — a metal Wapol can chew, swallow, and re-form into improved versions. Drum Island origin.

materials.name: Pyrobloin
materials.notes: Compound in Lunarian blood that fuels their inborn back-flame. Source of King's eternal fire.

materials.name: Dyna Stones
materials.notes: Skypiean volcanic rock that explodes on impact. Used as ammo by the Shandian warriors.

materials.name: Iron-Cloud / Sea-Cloud
materials.notes: Two cloud densities of Skypiea. Iron-cloud is solid (walkable); sea-cloud holds ships afloat in the sky.

materials.name: Yarukiman Mangrove sap
materials.notes: Source of Sabaody Bubble Coral. Produces the bubbles that coat ships for underwater travel.

materials.name: Amber Lead
materials.notes: Once-prized white-gold ore of Flevance — its mining caused a fatal disease that killed Law's family and the kingdom.

materials.name: Granite of Mary Geoise
materials.notes: Mariejois is built atop Pangaea Castle's granite — preserved from the Void Century. The Empty Throne sits on it.

materials.name: Kabuto-bone
materials.notes: Mink Tribe horn material — exceptionally hard, used in Mink jewellery and ceremonial weapons.
